_doc: Iran 'Entire History' video photo catalog for fetch-photos (2026-11-14). Each entry is searched on Wikimedia Commons, licence-checked (public domain, CC0, CC BY) and stored in photo-cache/. 'must' = title must contain one of these words; 'alt' = caption if nothing is found. Entries that print MISS: run List photo candidates, pin {id, file:'File:Exact Title.jpg'} and fetch again. Risk flags from the gate package are noted per entry; every flagged pin has a drawn fallback scene in the script, per the Germany rule (photos are planned, not hoped for).
